title: Female Equity Analysts and Corporate Environmental and Social Performance
eligible_reason: The only DiD (Table 3) is a two-period design: Table3_did_sample_psm5_20250505.dta has 60 observations = 30 firms x exactly one pre-year and one post-year around a brokerage-closure event (close_event_id), 5 treated firms (4 with 2009 post-year, 1 with 2018/2019) and 25 PSM-matched controls; regression reghdfe es treated_t_post post, a(gvkey fyear) cluster(gvkey). With one pre and one post observation per unit this is a two-period (pre/post collapsed) design, excluded by protocol; it also includes a post main effect and has only 5 treated units. All other tables regress E&S outcomes or report content on the number/presence of female analysts (continuous or time-varying regressors) with industry-year or firm-year/broker-year FE and time-varying controls.
design_notes: Package: README_File.docx, Code/Tables.do (Stata; Tables 1-5, 7-10), stm_output/stm_output.R (Figure 1, Table 6), Data/Table*_final.dta, Output/ with saved tables. Table 3 lines 78-97 of Code/Tables.do. Data derived from Compustat/CRSP, I/B/E/S, Refinitiv ESG, Trucost, Violation Tracker, Capital IQ, BoardEx (licensed) but final analysis files are shipped.
